citations.title: How Kelly Ortberg is rebuilding Boeing from the inside out

sentences.quote: He resolved the stoppage in a relatively fast 53 days
sentences.text: (Kelly) Ortberg, chief executive since August 2024, is widely credited with stabilizing Boeing after its safety and quality crises, ending a 53-day strike and raising over $24.3 billion in new capital to cover losses and bolster the balance sheet.

Execution has advanced but lagged plans: Boeing cleared the FAA capstone review for a 737 rate of 47 a month in May 2026, yet Ortberg said in September that reaching that rate consistently took longer than expected, and 475 deliveries through September still trailed Airbus.
FAA supervision has shifted from a hard numerical cap to performance-based oversight, while total debt still exceeds $50 billion, constraining capital allocation.
